note: Allowance units per feature (docs/usage-metering-20261115.md). The relay charges the newest version whose effectiveFrom has passed, while metering is switched on (inference.metering). Every usage record keeps the version it was charged under. Change a weight only by adding a new version: run scripts/usage-metering.ts suggest, then the owner approves the proposal and the agent appends it here. Never edit an existing version.

prices.source: Privatemode pricing page as copied in docs/privatemode-master-notes.md section 6 (owner's notes, read 11 November 2026). EUR, before VAT. Used by the scripts for euro estimates only; never charged to users.

versions.approvedBy: Owner decisions of 13 and 14 November 2026 (Thinking 5, two free code follow-ups); image, voice and research as proposed in the alpha configuration. Migrated unchanged on 15 November 2026; no new value.

chat-fast.source: median over recorded answers, blind benchmark, parity and smoke runs (docs/cost-weights-20261114.md)

chat-thinking.source: median, effort high and older max runs (docs/cost-weights-20261114.md)

code-followup.source: one calculation turn with code in Fast, both requests together, arithmetic set of 14 November; per-request count not recorded

research-run.source: three live runs of 14 November, plan and answer together

image.source: tiny synthetic picture only; a real photo is not measured

voice.source: Privatemode's rule of about 2,800 tokens per audio minute for a 2-minute recording; not measured
